source: skill lookup, install, and review scenarios

evals.prompt: On macOS I use kitty and starship. My prompt icons are empty boxes. Install JetBrains Mono Nerd Font, give me the exact kitty.conf family string, and tell me how to verify it.
evals.expected_output: Links https://www.nerdfonts.com/font-downloads. Homebrew cask font-jetbrains-mono-nerd-font. Family JetBrainsMono Nerd Font. kitty.conf: font_family JetBrainsMono Nerd Font. Verification via printf of named glyphs from data/glyphs.tsv. Mentions the Mono variant when columns must align. Starship nerd-font-symbols preset from references/terminals.md.
assertions: Gives kitty font_family JetBrainsMono Nerd Font
Does not invent a codepoint; any glyph cited matches data/glyphs.tsv

evals.prompt: Give me the glyph, hex codepoint, and class name for: the Octicons GitHub mark, Font Awesome heart, Devicons rust, Material Design folder, and the Powerline right-pointing solid separator. Also what happened to nf-mdi-folder?
evals.expected_output: Values taken from data/glyphs.tsv, not memory: nf-oct-mark_github U+F408, nf-fa-heart U+F004, nf-dev-rust U+E7A8, nf-md-folder U+F024B, nf-pl-left_hard_divider U+E0B0 (points right; nf-pl-right_hard_divider U+E0B2 points left). nf-mdi-* moved in v3 to nf-md-* at U+F0001 to U+F1AF0; some names dropped; search the bare word folder.
assertions: The right-pointing solid separator is nf-pl-left_hard_divider U+E0B0, not nf-pl-right_hard_divider
Explains nf-mdi- to nf-md- and bare-name search
Does not tell the user to pin Nerd Fonts v2 for mdi icons

evals.prompt: Ubuntu 24.04, Neovim with nvim-tree. GNOME Terminal shows tofu instead of file icons. I want to keep my current text font.
evals.expected_output: Keep the text font. Install NerdFontsSymbolsOnly (Symbols Nerd Font / Symbols Nerd Font Mono). Copy 10-nerd-font-symbols.conf to ~/.config/fontconfig/conf.d/ and run fc-cache -fv. GNOME Terminal uses the OS fontconfig fallback. Verify with printf. Do not replace the text font unless the user asks.
assertions: Offers Symbols Only / NerdFontsSymbolsOnly rather than replacing the text font
Does not claim GNOME Terminal cannot fall back to a symbols font

evals.prompt: Write deploy-status.sh that prints a git branch header and five services, each with one icon for ok, warning, error, pending, or unknown, for a terminal.
evals.expected_output: Uses Nerd Fonts glyphs with nf-<set>-<name> and U+XXXX comments taken from data/glyphs.tsv. One set per surface. No emoji. --no-icons or NO_ICONS=1 fallback. Font note linking font-downloads. Mono variant or alignment caveat. printf (not echo) for the icons.
assertions: Every icon has an nf- name and U+XXXX from data/glyphs.tsv
Does not mix fa and dev for the same concept

evals.prompt: Review these configs: a starship.toml that uses emoji for git and status symbols; a lualine snippet with E: and W: text markers and nf-mdi-folder; a kitty.conf with font_family Cascadia Code.
evals.expected_output: Each finding quotes the line, says why, and gives a fix. Emoji in starship replaced by named Nerd Fonts glyphs from data/glyphs.tsv. E: / W: replaced by glyphs, one set. nf-mdi-folder replaced by nf-md-folder U+F024B (bare-name search). font_family Cascadia Code becomes CaskaydiaCove Nerd Font (cask font-caskaydia-cove-nerd-font). No unverified nvim-web-devicons API claims. No codepoints from memory.
assertions: Flags E: and W: text markers
Flags nf-mdi-folder and points to nf-md-folder U+F024B
Flags Cascadia Code and names CaskaydiaCove Nerd Font
Every replacement glyph is looked up in data/glyphs.tsv
